Name: Kat's Brighter Hair
Author: Kattiana
Description:
This is a Content Patcher mod that brightens default / vanilla hairstyles so you can get nice light and bright hair colors.
It lets you get proper blondes, pastels, whites, and bright neon colors.

The previous three varieties have been merged into one mod, and you can now fully customize it in game.
There are a lot more options to choose from, and you can also go even brighter than before!
The outline and the main part of the hair is now controlled separately.
For both parts you can select options ranging from 10% to 100% brighter, with a 5% increase per step. (So 10%, 15%, 20%.. and all the way to 100%)


[b]How this mod works:[/b]
This mod swaps out the textures the game uses for the default hairstyles, with textures that have been brightened (you decide how much).
[u]Currently, this mod only brightens the default game hairstyles[/u].

[b]Using this mod with other mods that change default hair:[/b]
Normally, this mod will [u]not work[/u] with other Content Patcher mods that make changes to the default hairstyles, and you will have to pick one.
With the original version of this mod, there would sometimes be an error in SMAPI when you tried to use it with another hair mod that conflicts. Because of the new way this mod works, now there wont be an error that prevents both mods from running at all. Instead, this mod and the other may silently fight to be the last to edit the hairstyles. Old hair mods that use Load will be overwritten by mods that use Edit. Two mods that use Edit will fight over which one gets to make an edit last, and only one mod will win, depending on which mod is loaded last into the game. Which can result in either the changes from the other mod not showing up, or the changes from this mod not showing up.
In the future there may be compatibility patches added that allow users to use this mod together with other default hair mods. They will be listed on this page as compatible if they are added. Until then issues with this mod or another hair mod not showing all changes will likely be due to this conflict.
For compatibility requests see the section below.

[b]Using this mod with other mods that add hair:[/b]
This mod should now be fully usable alongside mods that add more hairstyles, however [u]this mod will not brighten hair from other mods[/u] unless a compatibility patch is made by me.
If you use other hairs you would like to see brightened, leave a link in the comment section on this mod page and I can check if the author of the other mod will give permission to modify their assets for compatibility with this mod. However I cant guarantee that it can be added.


[b]Updating the mod:[/b]
Please remove the old folder completely before installing the newest version.



[b]Notes:
[/b]The default hairstyles vary a little bit in how dark they are. This means that you might want to adjust your settings slightly when switching between the hairs with the biggest difference.
I have done my best to separate the outline and main parts of the hair. But if you feel like your favorite hair doesnt look quite right, feel free to leave a comment with a detailed picture, and I might be able to make a small adjustment to what is considered the outline vs the main part.
